Summons the ice's blessing to unfold an Ice Domain, knocking all enemies back within range. Then summons a comet to strike the targets, dealing Magic DMG and inflicting Frozen on all affected enemies.
Ice Domain
Within the Domain, restores 220 Ice Energy over time and gains Ultra Cold. Enemies within the domain are continuously Slowed until Frozen.
While in Ultra Cold, targets are treated as Frozen.

Tips: Don't use this skill when Ice Energy is about to cap. If you do, burn the Ice Energy quickly afterward. Skills enhanced by the Ultra Cold state are most effective when cast within this skill's duration.

Consumes 30 Courage to reel in the spinning lance and unleash a final piercing strike. The spiraling gust tears through the air, dealing sustained Attack DMG to enemies within range. The initial strike inflicts a 50% Wound on the target, lasting 10s.

Tips: Whenever you have enough Courage, use it on your most important skill.

Consumes 20 Energy to imbue the caster and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) with the forest power for 10s, healing them every second (Interval affected by Haste).

Tips: Cast after combat begins to provide steady team-wide healing over time.

Applies an acceleration effect to the caster. Increases MATK and reduces CD while active.

Tips: Cast when other skills are on CD .

Deals <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">500%</style> ATK to enemies hit along the path, and heals allies hit for <style="accent-gn">100%</style> ATK. Scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Special attack</style>. Casting it immediately refreshes Infusion.

Becomes frenzied, increasing all Flame Soul generated by 100%, and temporarily granting increased Crit.

Strategy: Must maintain during the burst window.

Double lightning-fast Iai Slashes. Inflicts Attack DMG on enemies at the cost of 50 Blade Intent. Once Attack Speed reaches 25%|50%|90%, deals 1|2|3 additional attack(s). If Blade Intent remains after the strike, the skill can be recast.

Tips: Core skill of the Spec. Consumes Blade Intent to deal DMG. Release when Blade Intent is at its maximum.

Enhanced <linktext=1507><style="ItemQuality_5">Moonstrike</style></linktext>. Throws a devastating thunderous cyclone forward, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">500%</style> ATK to enemies while gaining full <style="accent-gn">Blade Intent</style>. Scales with the Level/Tier of <linktext=1507><style="ItemQuality_5">Moonstrike</style></linktext>.

Consume all <style="accent-gn">Thunder Sigil</style> to unleash <style="accent-gn">5</style> rapid blade waves, dealing <style="magic">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">700%</style> ATK. Scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Special Attack</style>.

When dealing DMG, there is a chance to trigger Sigil: Lightning Chain.
Sigil: Deals 1 instance of Thunder Element damage to nearby enemies, bouncing up to 4 times.

Pro Tips: Strike fast when monsters are clustered so that you can start the chain reactions.

Rage
An initial cap of 100 points is assigned to this resource, which serves as the essential component for the execution of Special Attacks and Expertise. Restores 2 Rage upon taking DMG, subject to a maximum 0.5s CD.

Basic Attack: Halberd's Edge
A heavy four-strike combo with a wide-blade Guardblade, each strike dealing Attack DMG and generating 5 Rage.

Tips: Rage should be accumulated through the use of Basic Attacks.

Consumes 3 stacks of Performance Passion to play a tune that heals the caster and the nearby ally with the lowest HP (party members prioritized). The healing amount scales with the caster's MATK (plus an additional fixed heal equal to 3% of the target's Max HP).

Performance Passion: Required to perform music. 1 point is regenerated every 5s.

Tips: A healing skill with high uptime. Cast it to avoid letting Performance Passion overflow.

Holy Barrier
Consumes Holy Energy to raise your shield and emit the energy. Protects you and allies in a half-circle behind you, absorbing all incoming DMG within the area. The shield vanishes upon reaching its max absorb limit.

Summons Boss: Golden Juggernaut to provide a Shield for the caster.

Skill is not affected by CD.

Summons Boss: Lizardman King to deal Attack DMG to nearby enemies and continuously Silence targets.

Skill is not affected by CD.

Releases an energy wave, interrupting all targets within 5m and silencing them for 5s.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.
Creates a <linktext=1072><style="ItemQuality_5">Field</style></linktext>, continuously healing<style="accent-gn">allies</style> within it.
Burns yourself to gain power, entering Invigorated state. When active, gains a <style="accent-gn">DMG Boost</style>, but also takes more DMG.

Grants 35% additional DMG Reduction for 5s. This skill can store 2 charges.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.

Leaps into the air for a powerful strike. If the attack lands a <style="accent-gn">Crit</style>, the <style="accent-gn">CD </style> of this skill will be reset, and it can be cast up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times in succession. Each cast temporarily increases <style="accent-gn">Crit DMG</style>, stacking up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times.

Transforms into Elite: Inferno Goblin Mage and summons meteors from the sky, dealing Magic DMG and interrupting the target's actions.
Upon the skill cast, your Intellect is increased for a period.
[Boss Summon] - Inspecting Floating Eye. Fires continuously at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>.

Summons Tina to channel the power of time, reducing the Skill CDs of yourself and up to 10 surrounding allies for a certain period.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s.)

Resonates with the power of Elite: Goblin Wind Mage to transform into its form. Executes a frontal cone attack that deals <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3001><style="ItemQuality_5">silences</style></linktext> all affected targets.

Transforms into Elite: Mighty Colossus to charge and deal Attack DMG. The longer you charge, the greater the effect on Resilience breaking. Each stack increases the Resilience Break done by 50%. (3 stacks at Tier 3 and 6 stacks at Tier 5.)
Upon the skill cast, your Resilience Break Bonus is increased for a period.

Summons Elite: Muku Scout to chase the target, dealing Attack DMG.
Upon the skill cast, immediately gains full passive effects, and the stack count is doubled within 20s.

<style="accent-gn">Summons Boss</style>: Celestial Flier to charge forward, dealing Ice <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> and <linktext=3000><style="ItemQuality_5">interrupting</style></linktext> the targets' actions. After casting, your <style="accent-gn">Haste</style> is increased for a period of time.

Summons Boyce to create a field of frost by concentrating ice power, dealing Ice Magic DMG.
After casting, your ATK is increased for a period of time. Each cast of a Special Attack grants an additional increase, stacking up to 5 times. At max stacks, gain a bonus to Attack SPD and Casting SPD. Performing a Special Attack extends this bonus's duration by 3s, up to a max of 5 times (The ATK bonus's duration is not affected).
This skill holds 2 charges.

Summons Elite: Emerald Caprahorn to fire two consecutive projectiles, dealing Attack DMG to targets in the area.
After casting, your Haste is increased for a period of time.
Ready to Strike! Hold to charge, and the Golem claws the ground for charging. Release at the right moment to dash forward and reset the CD of Hunter's Pounce.
A leap combining strength and beauty, leaving a beautiful arc! CD rate +100% while sprinting.
Increase speed after release. The speed of skill CD increases while moving.
The dragon's form is as endless as the clouds it commands. After casting, it can transform into different parts.

When activated, enters the marching formation stance, during which the player can be connected with nearby players riding the Nutcracker's March and synchronizes movement to follow the target. Movement speed decreases while in the marching formation stance.
The maximum connection limit is 10 players.
Cancels the locked state and restores free movement.
